newsitem.title: UK: Tarmac to pay 22.5 mln stg after govt buy.
newsitem.headline: Tarmac to pay 22.5 mln stg after govt buy.

text.p: The British government said on Friday that after a much-delayed final assessment in the 1992 sale of PSA Projects to construction and building materials group Tarmac Plc it would be paid 22.5 milllion stg as a final settlement, plus interest. The Department of Environment said in a statement the adjustment followed a prolonged calculation of the net liabilities included within PSA Projects at the time of its privatisation.
The final sum to be paid by Tarmac was calculated by an independent arbiter appointed in October 1995.

Tarmac said last December, when the provisional ruling was laid down, that it expected the effect of the change in consideration to result in it making a goodwill adjustment of about 14 million stg that would reduce shareholders funds in 1996 but not affect its 1996 trading result.
